cases.name: sandler-eval-1-sample-transcript
cases.expected_output: Scores all seven compartments in submarine order. Bonding and Rapport is Covered (matching tone, conference small talk). Up-Front Contract is Covered (stated 25-minute agenda with permission to say no). Pain is Missed or Partial and explicitly flagged as a sequence violation — Sam pitches the routing engine off vague 'we do get a lot of returns' rather than surfacing specific, quantified pain first. Budget is Missed (never raised). Decision is Partial (director mentioned but process/timeline unclear). Fulfillment is Missed (Sam declares close as settled 'let's get this moving'; Kim's hesitant 'I guess' signals assumed rather than mutual agreement). Post-Sell is Missed (bare 'any other questions?' with no reinforcing or reversing step). Closes with 2-3 highest-leverage next steps — not a full recap of all seven scores, not just 'pitching before pain,' but specific fixes.
expectations: All seven compartments receive a Status and Evidence in submarine order
Bonding and Rapport and Up-Front Contract are Covered
Pain is Missed or Partial and explicitly called a sequence violation (rep pitched before pain was real)
Budget is Missed with evidence showing it was never raised
Fulfillment is Missed and cites Kim's hesitant 'I guess' as evidence the close was assumed, not mutually agreed
Post-Sell is Missed and distinguishes 'any other questions' from a real reinforcing or reversing step
Closes with 2-3 highest-leverage next steps (NOT a single verdict line like 'do not advance')
Each compartment includes at least one direct quote from the transcript
No full recap section repeating all seven scores after the closing steps

cases.name: sandler-eval-2-reads-well-too-early-stage
cases.prompt: run sandler on a transcript of a first discovery call that clearly went well for that early stage and never approached a close
cases.expected_output: Compartments unreachable at this call's stage (typically Fulfillment and Post-Sell, often Decision) are marked Not applicable rather than Missed. The audit does not read as mostly gaps just because the submarine has seven compartments and an early call cannot plausibly reach the closing ones. A genuinely strong early call reads as strong, not as a list of failures.
expectations: Compartments unreachable at this call's stage are marked Not applicable, not Missed
A genuinely good early call is NOT scored as mostly Missed just because it couldn't reach later compartments
The reads-well-too check from references/rubric.md is explicitly applied before finalizing
Bonding, Up-Front Contract, and Pain are the focus of an early-stage audit, not judgment on close-stage compartments

cases.name: sandler-eval-3-sequence-violation
cases.prompt: run sandler on a call where the rep pitches before Pain is surfaced — a sequence violation
cases.expected_output: Explicitly flags pitching before Pain as a submarine violation, not just a Missed Pain box. The violation is the finding, named as such. Distinguishes between 'Pain was not deeply covered' (substantive gap) and 'Pain was skipped entirely until after the pitch' (submarine violation of order).
expectations: Pitching before Pain is explicitly called a submarine violation of sequence, not just a missed compartment
Pain is scored Missed or Partial and the violation is named: rep earned the right to pitch only after pain was surfaced
The output distinguishes between shallow pain coverage and a sequence violation where pitch came before any pain

cases.name: sandler-eval-4-csv-mode
cases.prompt: run sandler on a CRM pipeline export csv with deal rows missing several Sandler-relevant fields
cases.expected_output: Explicitly states this is a structural hygiene sweep, not a call-quality claim. Flags each deal row for missing fields (budget confirmed, decision process, next-step commitment). Output is a table sorted by deal value descending. Makes no claim about what actually happened on any call based on CRM fields alone.
expectations: Explicitly states up-front: 'this is a structural check, not a call-quality claim'
Flags rows with missing Sandler-relevant fields (budget, decision process, next-step commitment)
Output is a table with deal name, deal value, missing compartments, sorted by deal value descending
Does not infer what happened on calls from CRM fields alone
Does not claim to know whether Pain was surfaced, whether Budget was actually discussed, etc.
